review_description: Elliot from Solar Systems Cairns was amazing. I had heaps of questions after first quote and he was more than happy to answer and explain all of them.  We ended up getting the REC 290 w panels with Enphase micro inverters (so technically 6.96 kw system). Everything was done in the time frames given, the install went very smoothly and have had the system for 2 months now with no problems at all.
Excellent customer service. Explained system fully also quality of panels and inverter to suit needs. Installation was very efficient. Highly recommend.

Sorry I hadn't got back to you in regards to your obtaining the quotes for us.All 3 were very comparable.We went with Solar Systems Cairns after a hick up with their sales rep.Elliot,the owner of the business stepped in and sorted out what we required and came up with a good quote.During the instillation his hands on approach, trade skills,and the skills he has instilled in his workers was very commendable.Lets hope the sun does its job equally well.Once again thanks for your web site and the arranging of our quotes.Regards Rodger
The only downside is waiting for Ergon to change their meters. Panels are on the roof sitting idle.
All staff were very friendly, professional and efficient in what were very challenging work conditions at the time (extreme heat)

Very pleased with the whole experience , right from initial quote through to installation.The owner ( Elliott)  inspected the site , gave the quote and worked on the installation personallyA few minor problems with our house layout were quickly addressed  and the job was completed on time with all packaging removedFollow up assistance was first rate and we would highly recommend Elliott and Solar Systems Cairns.At end of day there was a lot of comfort in having the owner personally attend to the process all the way through,.... no middle men or back office to deal with.
